label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger Woods' Return
items.text: Tiger Woods is set to make his long-awaited return to competitive golf at the Hero World Challenge next week.

items.headline: Scheffler Defends Title
items.text: Scottie Scheffler committed to defend his Optum Golf Channel Games title on Dec. 16 in Jupiter, Florida, setting up a major rematch with Rory McIlroy.

items.headline: Clark's LIV Golf Decision
items.text: Wyndham Clark revealed he had a price in mind that would have convinced him to leave the PGA Tour for LIV Golf but ultimately declined to join.
